full_prompt_en: The image is a polished mid-century painted illustration of a smiling woman seated on a pale kitchen floor. She occupies the center and right side, leaning back on one hand while the other holds an open printed magazine angled toward her lap. Her crossed legs extend diagonally toward the lower left, ending in glossy red heeled sandals. Short brown curls and a small colorful headband frame her face; vivid red lips and bright cheeks catch the viewer's attention. Her fitted red top has narrow tied shoulder straps, and a light floral skirt drapes over the floor around her hips. At the left stands a large dark green refrigerator with a chrome horizontal handle and a red checked towel above; pale cabinet doors form a simple warm backdrop at the right. A bowl or cluster of yellow lemons, a few red fruits and a dark bottle sit near her supporting hand at the lower right. The surfaces are rendered in smooth, carefully blended oil-paint-like strokes: skin has warm peach highlights and soft brown shadow, fabric has crisp printed flowers, and the refrigerator has a restrained enamel sheen. Warm domestic light falls from the upper left, creating a clear shadow beneath her legs and along the cabinet base. The palette balances cherry red, creamy ivory, deep bottle green and sunny yellow. A gently theatrical smile, precise costume detail and orderly domestic objects give the square image the buoyant charm of an illustrated advertisement.
full_prompt_zh: 画面是一幅精致的世纪中期彩绘插画，一位微笑女子坐在浅色厨房地面上。她占据中央和右侧，一只手向后支撑身体，另一只手拿着朝腿上倾斜的展开杂志。交叠的双腿向左下方斜伸，脚上是发亮的红色高跟凉鞋。棕色短卷发和小巧的彩色发带围住面孔；鲜红嘴唇与明亮双颊抓住视线。贴身红上衣有细窄的系带肩带，浅色花裙铺垂在臀部周围的地面。左侧是一台大型深绿色冰箱，带横向镀铬把手，上方挂红格毛巾；右侧浅色橱柜门构成简单而温暖的背景。右下方、她支撑的手旁放着一碗或一簇黄色柠檬、几颗红色水果和一只深色瓶子。表面以平滑而细心融合的油画式笔触塑造：皮肤有暖桃色高光与柔和棕影，布料有清楚的小花印纹，冰箱带克制的珐琅光泽。温暖的家居光从左上落下，在双腿下和柜脚边形成明确阴影。配色以樱桃红、奶油白、深瓶绿和明亮黄色相平衡。略具舞台感的笑容、准确服饰细节与整齐日常物件，赋予正方形画面广告插画般轻快的魅力。
style_prompt_en: Polished mid-century painted illustration has smooth oil-like blending, warm peach illumination, crisp patterned detail, restrained enamel highlights, and carefully placed cast shadows. Cherry red, creamy ivory, deep bottle green and sunny yellow form an upbeat but controlled palette. Slight theatricality, clean staging and subtle brush texture give the square surface the finish of a vintage print advertisement.
style_prompt_zh: 精致的世纪中期彩绘插画呈现平滑的油画式融合、暖桃色照明、清晰纹样、克制的珐琅高光与位置明确的投影。樱桃红、奶油白、深瓶绿和明黄组成轻快却有控制的配色。略带舞台感的布置、清楚构图和细微笔触，使正方形画面具有复古印刷广告的完成度。
theme_en: A smiling woman reading beside fruit in a sunlit vintage kitchen
theme_zh: 复古厨房里，微笑女子在水果旁读报
name: Gil Elvgren
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
